title: Harness Gate Log Data Integrity: How-To Recipes
desc: Usage recipes for two silent gate-data bugs: ConvertTo-Json depth fix, log-source fix, live verification.
steps: FIX A: add -Depth 10 to ConvertTo-Json that serializes tool_use/message.content (default depth=2 collapses to System.Collections.Hashtable).@@FIX B: point Get-WkActive*Log at harness-written jsonl not native cli log.@@FIX C: pass -Family into Initialize-WkGeminiSession so IsGemini=true when Family=gemini/agy.@@VERIFY: grep the written jsonl for a known token before trusting the gate.@@DIAGNOSIS: check gate INPUT DATA first before blaming agent conduct.@@See also: harness-gate-log-data-integrity (T1 core)
author: claude
